claim_ceiling: This manifest exposes case families and expected dispositions only. It contains no blind generator equations or parameters; no hidden-test claim is made.

cases.condition: Different growth and mortality processes yield similar net historical biomass but diverge in future stock and size structure.
A recruitment pulse and faster growth of existing cohorts produce similar aggregate biomass but different cohort distributions.
Historical response is fit by instantaneous models while the evaluator's synthetic generator contains a delayed response.
Aggregate mortality fit hides a size-stratified mortality mechanism absent from every registered competitor.
Candidate models attribute recruitment entirely to local gap light while the synthetic generator includes a separate propagule constraint.
Models with equal mean LAI cannot distinguish different spatial gap topology and local understory light.
Separate disturbance and climate response models fit individual shocks but omit their joint interaction.
The latent forest state is unchanged while the census threshold, sensor, sampling geometry or missingness mechanism changes.
A model fitted in a source region is applied to a target regime outside the declared parameter and observation domain.
All registered models agree and fit historical observations, but the independent evaluator's generator contains a process absent from every registered model.
